### 2-2 Simulation Driver & Tick Clock â€” Logic

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/SimulationDriverTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- AC-1.1: 600 steps in 10s at >60 FPS (Â±0 steps)
- AC-1.2: 30 FPS 2Ã—FIXED_DT frames â†’ 600 steps, no discard
- AC-1.3: 18ms frame â†’ ~1.33ms accumulator remainder
- AC-1.4: Physics.Simulate(FIXED_DT) once per accumulated step; SimulationMode.Script; no auto physics
- AC-1.5: clamp to 2Ã—FIXED_DT; at most 2 steps per frame
- AC-1.6: time above clamp permanently discarded; no catch-up next frame
- AC-1.8: sim_time = activeRaceStepCount Ã— FIXED_DT within Â±1e-6

- AC-3.1a: CaptureLatestRawSample exactly once before accumulator in same Update; no script-order assumption

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Final accumulator remainder below FIXED_DT must not produce an extra step; zero-duration frames
